={
  "records": [
    {
      "id": "{{ $('getteable').item.json.records[0].id }}",
      "fields": {
        "Name": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].name.firstName }} {{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].name.lastName }}",
        "Email": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].emails.primaryEmail }}",
        "Phone": {{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].phones.primaryPhoneNumber }},
        "Job Title": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].jobTitle }}",
        "Department": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].department }}",
        "Seniority": [
          "{{ ({
            'C_LEVEL': 'C-Level',
            'C-LEVEL': 'C-Level',
            'CEO': 'C-Level',
            'CFO': 'C-Level',
            'COO': 'C-Level',
            'CTO': 'C-Level',
            'CIO': 'C-Level',
            'CHIEF_EXECUTIVE_OFFICER': 'C-Level',
            'CHIEF_FINANCIAL_OFFICER': 'C-Level',
            'CHIEF_OPERATING_OFFICER': 'C-Level',
            'CHIEF_TECHNOLOGY_OFFICER': 'C-Level',
            'VP': 'VP',
            'VICE_PRESIDENT': 'VP',
            'DIRECTOR': 'Director',
            'MANAGER': 'Manager',
            'SENIOR_MANAGER': 'Manager',
            'TEAM_MANAGER': 'Manager',
            'INDIVIDUAL_CONTRIBUTOR': 'Manager',
            'INDIVIDUAL CONTRIBUTOR': 'Manager'
          })[$json.data.people[$itemIndex].seniority?.toUpperCase()] || $json.data.people[$itemIndex].seniority || 'Unknown' }}"
        ],
        "LinkedIn": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].linkedinLink.primaryLinkUrl }}",
        "Buyer Persona": [
          "{{ ({
            'ECONOMIC_BUYER': 'Economic Buyer',
            'DECISION_MAKER': 'Decision Maker',
            'TECHNICAL_BUYER': 'Technical Buyer',
            'CHAMPION_INFLUENCER': 'Champion Influencer',
            'USER': 'User',
            'GATEKEEPER': 'Gatekeeper'
          })[$json.data.people[$itemIndex].buyerPersona] || 'Unknown' }}"
        ],
        "Persona Score": {{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].personalScore }},
        "Decision Role": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].decisionRole }}",
        "Pain Points": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].painPoints }}",
        "Buying Motivation": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].buyingMotivation }}",
        "Objections": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].objections }}",
        "Contact Status": "{{ $json.data.people[$itemIndex].contactStatus }}"
      }
    }
  ]
}

={
  "icpScore": {{ $('Code in JavaScript4').item.json.icpScore }},
  "icpTier": "{{ $('Code in JavaScript4').item.json.icpTier === 'A+' ? 'A_PLUS' : $('Code in JavaScript4').item.json.icpTier }}",
  "intentScore":{{ $('Code in JavaScript4').item.json.intentScore }},
  "icpReason":"{{ $('Code in JavaScript4').item.json.icpReason }}",
  "recommendedService":"{{ $('Code in JavaScript4').item.json.recommendedService }}",
  "leadSource" :"{{ $json.data.companies[$itemIndex].leadSource }}"
}

={
  "records": [
    {
      "id": "{{ $json.records[$itemIndex].id }}",
      "fields": {
        "Company Name": "{{ $json.records[$itemIndex].fields["Company Name"] }}",
        "Website": "{{ $json.records[$itemIndex].fields.Website }}",
        "Industry": "{{ $json.records[$itemIndex].fields.Industry }}",
        "Employee Count": {{ $json.records[$itemIndex].fields["Employee Count"] }},
        "Revenue": {{ $json.records[$itemIndex].fields.Revenue }},
        "Country": "{{ $json.records[$itemIndex].fields.Country }}",
        "City": "{{ $json.records[$itemIndex].fields.City }}",
        "Technology Stack": "{{ $json.records[$itemIndex].fields["Technology Stack"] }}",
        "Company Stage": "{{ $json.records[$itemIndex].fields["Company Stage"] }}",
        "ICP Score": {{ $('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.icpScore }},
        "ICP Tier": {{ JSON.stringify([
  $('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.icpTier === 'A_PLUS'
    ? 'A+'
    : $('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.icpTier || ''
]) }},
        "Intent Score": {{ $('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.intentScore }},
        "Lead Score": {{ $('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.leadScore }},
        "Lead Type": {{ JSON.stringify([$('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.leadType === 'WARM' ? 'Warm' : $('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.leadType === 'COLD' ? 'Cold' : $('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.leadType === 'HOT' ? 'Hot' : $('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.leadType || '']) }},
        "Recommended Service": "{{ $('Code in JavaScript7').item.json.recommendedService }}",
        "ICP Reason": "{{ $('HTTP Request2').item.json.data.companies[$itemIndex].icpReason }}",
        "Buying Signals": "{{ $('HTTP Request2').item.json.data.companies[$itemIndex].buyingSignals }}",
        "Pain Points": "{{ $('HTTP Request2').item.json.data.companies[$itemIndex].painPoints }}",
        "Lead Source": "{{ $('HTTP Request2').item.json.data.companies[$itemIndex].leadSource }}",
        "Last Enriched": "{{ $('HTTP Request2').item.json.data.companies[$itemIndex].lastEnriched }}",
        "Last Scored": "{{ $('HTTP Request2').item.json.data.companies[$itemIndex].lastScored }}"
      }
    }
  ]
}
